1.text: Introduction
[The] paraphrase concerning the unbegotten Spirit, which Derdekeas revealed to me, Shem, in accord with the desire of the Majesty.
Derdekeas Teaches Shem about the Three Roots

My thought inside my body snatched me away from my race, conveying me to the height of the creation, near the light that was shining on the entire region. In that place I saw no earthly likeness, but only light, and my thought detached itself from the body of darkness, as if sleeping. I heard a voice speaking to me:

Shem, given that you originate from a pure power, and that you are the first being on earth, hear and understand what I will speak to you first, concerning the mighty powers who existed in the beginning, before I had appeared, when Light and Darkness existed, and a Spirit in the midst of them. Because your root, the unbegotten Spirit, plummeted into oblivion, I am disclosing to you the truth concerning the powers.

Light was thought, replete with hearing, and Logos, unified as a single form, and Darkness was [2] wind in the waters, and his Mind clothed in an erratic fire, and the Spirit in their midst was a calm, low-burning light. These are the three roots, each individually prevailing by itself, and concealed from each other.
The Light of the Spirit and the Mind of Darkness

Light, however, because he possessed much power, was able to know the depth of Darkness, as well as his condition, which was a crooked root, but the crookedness of Darkness was an absence of insight, thinking there was no one superior to him, and for as long as he could endure the strain of his wickedness, he was covered over with the water. And he stirred himself, and the Spirit became frightened by the splashing. He elevated his position, and he saw a large, dark body of water, and he became nauseous, and the thought of the Spirit gazed down, beholding the infinite Light, but he was ignored by the bad root; and by the desire of the great Light, the dark body of water divided, and Darkness surfaced, concealed in evil ignorance, even so that Mind could divide itself from him, because he had become arrogant in it.

And when he had stirred himself, [3] the light of the Spirit appeared to him. When he beheld it, he was astounded, knowing not that another power was superior to him. And when, in contrast to the Spirit, he saw how dark his likeness was, he was pained, and in his pain, he lifted up his Mind, the eye of vile bitterness, to the height of the members of Darkness. With a member of the Spirit, he made his Mind assume shape, imagining that by gazing at his vileness, he could be equal to the Spirit, but he was unable, because what he wanted to do was impossible, and it failed to come to pass. However, so that the Mind of Darkness, the eye of vile bitterness, would not be destroyed, because he had been made somewhat similar (to the Spirit), he rose up and flashed with a flaming light over all of Hades, in an attempt to make the perfect light (of his equality) appear, because the Spirit exploited all forms of Darkness.
The Appearance of the Son of the Majesty and the Womb

Given that with his Majesty he had appeared, even the lofty infinite Light appeared, because he rejoiced greatly. He desired to show himself to the Spirit, and the likeness of the lofty Light appeared to the unbegotten Spirit.

[4] I appeared. [I] am the son of the indestructible, infinite Light. I appeared in the likeness of the Spirit, because I am the beam of the cosmic Light, and his ap-pearance to me was so that the Mind of Darkness could not stay in Hades, because the Darkness had made himself to resemble his Mind inside some of the members.

Shem, when <I> appeared in (the likeness), so that Darkness would grow dark before himself, in accord with the desire of the Majesty, so that the Darkness would be divested[1] of every form of his power, Mind removed the erratic fire, with which it had been covered, from the midst of Darkness and the water, and out of Darkness the water turned into a cloud, and from out of the cloud the womb assumed shape.

The erratic fire, being deviant, approached (the womb), and when Darkness saw (the womb), he was polluted, and arousing the water, he stroked the womb. His Mind was liquefied downward to the depths of Nature. It united with the power of the bitterness of Darkness, and the eye (of the womb) was ripped open by the evil so that she would not again give birth to Mind, because it was [5] the seed of Nature from the dark root, and when from the dark power Nature had become pregnant with Mind, every likeness assumed shape in her.

And when Darkness had obtained the likeness of Mind, it looked like the Spirit, because Nature stood up to banish it. She had no power against it, given that she possessed no form from the Darkness, because she gave birth to it inside the cloud, and the cloud glowed. A Mind appeared inside it like a fearsome, dangerous fire. (Mind) rammed against the unbegotten Spirit, given that it possessed a likeness from him.
Nature Separated into Four Sections

Next, so that Nature would be emptied of the erratic fire, straightaway Nature was separated into four sections. They transformed into clouds with various appearances. They were called “Hymen,” “Placenta,” “Power,” “Water”; and Hymen, and Placenta, and Power were erratic fires. And (Mind) was taken out of the midst of Darkness and Water, given that Mind was in the midst of Nature, and the dark power, so that the dangerous waters would not cleave to it.

[6] On account of this, Nature was separated, in accord with my desire, so that Mind may go back to its power, which had been taken away from it by the dark root, which was joined with (Mind). And (the dark root) materialized inside the womb, and when Nature was separated, he separated from the dark power which he had come to have from Mind. (Mind) proceeded into the midst of the power, this being the central realm of Nature, and the Spirit of light was astounded when Mind loaded him down, and the power of his astonishment threw off the load, and it retreated to its heat, donning the light of the Spirit. And when Nature had distanced itself from the power of the light of the Spirit, the load came back, and the astonishment of the light of the <Spirit> threw off the load. It cleaved to the cloud of Hymen, and every cloud of Darkness that had been separated from Hades shouted on account of the strange power.
The Son of the Majesty has Compassion on the Light of the Spirit

The Spirit of light had entered among them, and by the desire of the Majesty, the Spirit looked up at the infinite Light, so that his light could receive compassion, and (so that) the likeness could be lifted up out of Hades. And when the Spirit had looked, I, the Son of the Majesty, flowed [7] out like a wave of glowing light, and like a blast of wind from the immortal Spirit, and from the cloud of Hymen I blew on the astonishment of the unbegotten Spirit, and (the cloud) separated, and shined light on the clouds, which separated so that the Spirit could come back. On account of this, Mind assumed shape, ending his repose, because Hymen of Nature was a cloud that cannot be grasped, being a huge fire. In a similar way, Afterbirth of Nature was the cloud of silence, being an imposing fire, and the Power which was joined with Mind was also a cloud of Nature joined with Darkness, which had aroused Nature to polluted acts, and the dark water was a fearsome cloud, and the root of Nature, which was located beneath, was crooked, given that it is a heavy load and dangerous. The root was blind concerning the incomprehensible confined light, given that it possessed several forms. And I had compassion on the light <of> the Spirit, which the Mind had obtained.
The Son of the Majesty Dons the Garment of the Light of the Majesty

I returned to my place to pray to the lofty, infinite Light [8], so that the power <of the light> of the Spirit would increase in the place, and would be filled, expelling dark pollution. And I said in reverence:

“You are the root of the Light. Your concealed form has been revealed, O lofty, infinite one. May the entire power of the Spirit expand, and may it be replete with its light, O infinite Light, that he will be unable to unite with the unbegotten Spirit, and that the power of the astonishment will be unable to unite with Nature. Let it be as the Majesty desires.”

My prayer was granted, and from the Majesty, the voice of the Logos was heard speaking <to> the unbegotten Spirit: “Behold, the power has been perfected. He whom I revealed has appeared in the Spirit.”

I will appear again. I am Derdekeas, the Son of the unpolluted, infinite Light. The light of the infinite Spirit descended to a weak nature for a brief period until all of the pollution of nature was made empty, and so that the darkness of Nature would be accused. I donned my garment, the garment of the light of the Majesty, which I (myself) am. I assumed the form of the [9] Spirit to take into account the entire light in the depths of Darkness.
The Spirit Praises the Lofty Light

In accord with the desire of the Majesty, so that by means of the Logos the Spirit would be filled with his light, apart from the power of the infinite Light, and at my desire, the Spirit stood up by his own power. His enormity was given to him so that he could be filled with his entire light, and leave behind the entire weight of Darkness, because a dark fire was back there, which blew against the Spirit, and the Spirit was glad on account of his being defended from the fearsome water, but his light did not equal that of the Majesty. However, <that which> he was given by the infinite Light was so that in each of his members he would look like one single image of light.

And when the Spirit had stood up over the water, its dark likeness became apparent, and the Spirit praised the lofty Light: “You alone are truly the infinite one, because you are superior to everything that is unbegotten, because you have defended me from Darkness, and at your desire I stood up over the power of Darkness.”

And so that nothing could be concealed from you, Shem, there came into existence the thought, which the Spirit, who is from the Greatness, had contemplated, [10] given that Darkness was unable [to] control his evil. When, however, it had appeared, the way three roots had existed from the beginning was made known. Had Darkness been capable of bearing his evil load, Mind would not have separated from him, and a different power would not have appeared. However, from the time it had appeared, I have been seen, the Son of the Majesty, so that the light of the Spirit would not grow dim[2], and that Nature would not control it, because it had looked at me, and by the desire of the Greatness, my purity was revealed, so that what pertains to power might become evident.
The Son of the Majesty is Superior to the Logos

You are the great power which has come into being, and I am the perfect Light over the Spirit and Darkness, the one who humiliates Darkness for the intercourse of the unclean stroking, because by means of the separation of Nature, the Majesty desired to be protected by praise up to the very summit of the thought of the Spirit, and the Spirit obtained repose with his power, because the image of the Light cannot be separated from the unbegotten Spirit. And those who give laws have not named him after any cloud of Nature, nor can they be named, because every likeness [11] into which Nature is divided is a power of the erratic fire of the material sperm. The (fire) that gains for itself the power of Darkness made it captive in the midst of its members.

And by the desire of the Majesty, so that the Mind, and the entire light of the Spirit, would be defended from every load and labor of Nature, a voice came from the Spirit to the cloud of Hymen, and the light of the astonishment commenced rejoicing with the voice given to him, and the great Spirit of light dwelt inside the cloud of Hymen. He praised the infinite Light and the cosmic likeness, who I am, the Son of the Majesty, saying: “Anasses, Duses,[3] you are the infinite Light who by the desire of the Majesty was granted to establish each light of the Spirit in its place, and to separate Mind from Darkness, because it was unjust that the light of the Spirit remain in Hades, because at your desire the Spirit stood up to behold your greatness.”

The reason I have spoken these matters to you, Shem, is so that you would know [12] that my likeness, the Son of the Majesty, originates from my infinite thought, given that for him I am a cosmic likeness which lies not. I am superior to every truth and element of the Logos. His likeness is in my glorious garment of light, being the voice of infinite thought. We comprise that one, only light which came into being. He appeared in a different root so that the power of the Spirit would be lifted up from frail Nature, because by the desire of the great Light, I exited from the lofty Spirit, descending to the cloud of Hymen, lacking my cosmic garment.
The Son of the Majesty Dons the Primal Cloud of Hymen of Nature

And from the Spirit, the Logos carried me to himself, into the primal cloud of Hymen of Nature, and I donned this, of which the Majesty and the unbegotten Spirit made me deserving, and by the desire of the Majesty, the triadic unity of my garment appeared inside the cloud, in a single form, and the light of my garment covered my likeness, and the cloud became turbulent, and it was incapable of enduring my likeness. It discarded the first power, which it had acquired from the Spirit, that which from the beginning had shone on him, before <I> appeared in the Logos of[4] the Spirit.

The cloud [13] was incapable of enduring both of them, and the light which had exited from the cloud went through the silence, until it reached the middle region, and by the desire of the Majesty, the light <of> the Spirit that dwells in silence was joined to (the silence) which had been separated from the Spirit of light. It had been separated from the light by the cloud of silence. The cloud became turbulent. He was the one who granted repose to the flame of fire. He inhibited the dark womb so that he would not reveal further seed from Darkness. He restrained them in their place inside the cloud in the middle realm of Nature. They grew disturbed, given that they did not understand where they were, because they were not in possession of the cosmic knowledge of the Spirit.
The Son of the Majesty Helps Those Dwelling in Darkness, but Nature Grows Strong

And facing the infinite Light, I prayed to the Majesty that the erratic power of the Spirit would move back and forth, and that the dark womb would be inactive, and that my likeness would appear inside the cloud of Hymen, as though I were covered with the light of the Spirit which proceeded in front of me, and by the desire of the Majesty and by means of the prayer, I entered into the cloud so that by means of my garment from the power [14] of the Spirit, the fullness of the Logos would impart power to the members dwelling in Darkness, because on their account I had appeared in this lowly place.

The reason for this is that I am a helper to all who have been named, because when I appeared inside the cloud, the light of the Spirit began to separate itself from the fearsome water and clouds of fire which had been separated from dark Nature, and I offered to them eternal praise to prevent them from again committing the polluted behavior.

And the light in Hymen was troubled by my power, and it went through my middle realm. It was replete with the cosmic thought, and by means of the Logos of the light of the Spirit, it regained its repose. It obtained form with its root, and glowed apart from deficiency, and the light which had emerged with it from the silence proceeded in the middle realm, and went back to the place.

And the cloud glowed, and from it emerged a ravenous fire, and the part of it which had separated from the astonishment donned oblivion. It was fooled by the fire of Darkness, and the blow of its astonishment threw off the load from the [15] cloud. It was evil because it was polluted, and the fire joined to the water, so that the waters would become dangerous, and Nature, which had been troubled, straightaway stood up from the inactive waters, because her ascent had been dishonorable, and Nature appropriated for herself the power of fire. She grew strong on account of the light of the Spirit dwelling in Nature. Her likeness appeared in the water with the shape of a fearsome beast of several faces, being crooked underneath.
The Son of the Majesty Descends to the Nether World

A light descended to Chaos, filled with haze and dust, to wound Nature, and the light of the astonishment dwelling in the middle realm approached it after he had thrown off the load from Darkness. He was glad when the Spirit stood up, because from the clouds he had gazed down toward the dark waters at the light dwelling in the depths of Nature.

Consequently, I appeared so that I would get a chance to descend to the nether world, to the light of the Spirit which was weighted down, so that I could defend him from the harm of the load. And by means of his gazing down at the dark realm, the light again [16] ascended so that the womb could again ascend from the water.

She ascended by my desire. The eye opened itself cunningly, and the light which had appeared in the middle realm, which had separated itself from the astonishment, reposed and illuminated her, and the womb witnessed things she had not beheld (before), and she was glad with joy in the light, even though this did not belong to her, the one which in her evil had appeared in the middle realm when (the light) illuminated her, and in this way the womb witnessed things she had not beheld (before).

And again she was carried down to the water. She imagined she had attained to the power of light, and she knew not that her root had been rendered inactive by the likeness of the Light, and that (the light) had hastened to her.
The Son of the Majesty Appears in the Cloud of Hymen and in the Middle Realm

The light was astounded, the one dwelling in the middle realm, and which was the beginning and end. His thought consequently looked straight up at the lofty Light, and he cried out, and said: “Lord, have mercy on me, because my light and my toil were misguided, because if your goodness does not make me firm, I will not be aware of where I am.”

And when the Majesty had heard him, he showed him mercy. And I appeared in the cloud of Hymen, in the silence, [17] not wearing my sacred garment. In accord with my desire I praised my garment which possesses three forms in the cloud of Hymen, and the light in the silence, which is from the power that is glad, enclosed me, I wearing it. And two of its parts looked like a single form. The other parts were not visible because of the fire. I was rendered incapable of speaking in the cloud of Hymen, because its fire was fearsome, reaching upwards, without lowering itself.

And so that that my greatness and the Logos might become visible, I similarly put my other garment in the cloud of the silence. I proceeded into the middle realm and donned the light dwelling in it, which was submerged in oblivion and separated from the Spirit of astonishment, because he had thrown off the load. At my desire, nothing mortal was visible to him. Instead, deathless entities were the only things the Spirit allowed him to see, and in the thought of the Light he said, “AI EIS AI OU PHAR DOU IA EI OU: I have entered into a great rest, so that in its root he would give rest to my light, and would bring it out from [18] dangerous Nature.”
The Son of the Majesty Dons a Garment of Fire

By the desire of the Majesty, I then removed my garment of light. I donned a different garment, of fire, which has no shape, which originates from the Mind of the power, which was set apart and made ready for me in the middle realm, in accord with my desire, because the middle realm obscured it with a dark power so that I would approach and don it. I descended into Chaos to rescue from it the entirety of light, because apart from the power of Darkness, I would not be able to resist Nature.

As soon as I had entered into Nature, she was unable to resist my power. Instead, I leaned against her watchful eye, which was a light from the Spirit, because the Spirit had made it ready for me to be a garment and a repose. On account of me he opened his eyes downward to Hades, and he allowed Nature his voice for a period of time.

And my garment of fire, in accord with the desire of the Majesty, descended to the strong one, and to the filthy region of Nature which the power of darkness was covering, and my garment rubbed Nature with what covered her, and her filthy femaleness became strong. And the furious womb ascended and [19] turned Mind dry, looking like a fish with a droplet of fire, and the power of fire. And when Nature had thrown off Mind, she grew disturbed, and she wept. When she was wounded and in tears, she threw off the power of the Spirit, remaining silent like me.

I donned the light of the Spirit, and I rested with my garment over the spectacle of the fish, and so that the actions of Nature would be censured, given that she is blind, multifarious animal forms emerged from her, of the same number as the passing winds. They all came into existence in Hades, seeking the light of Mind which bestows form. They could not resist it. I was glad on account of their ignorance. They discovered me, the Son of the Majesty, in front of the womb of many forms.
Nature Agrees to Create the Heavens and the Earth

I donned the beast, and presented to (Nature) a great request, that heaven and earth would come into existence, so that the entirety of the light would ascend, because the only way the power of the Spirit could be removed from captivity was for me to appear to her in the shape of an animal. For this, she treated me agreeably, [20] like I was her own son, and because of my request, Nature stood up, given that she possesses (some) of the power of the Spirit, as well as Darkness and the fire, because she had removed her forms from herself.

When she had thrown it off, she blew on the water. Heaven was created, and from the foam of heaven, the earth came into existence, and at my desire, it produced every kind of food, agreeing with the number of the beasts, and it produced dew from the winds for all of you and for those who will be begotten again and again on the earth, because the earth possessed a power of erratic fire. This is why it produced every (kind of) seed.

And when heaven and earth had been created, my garment of fire stood up in the midst of the cloud of Nature, shining on the entire world, until Nature was withered. Darkness, which was (earth’s) garment, was thrown into the dangerous waters. The middle realm was purified of Darkness, but the womb mourned over what had transpired.

She noticed in her parts water like a mirror. On noticing, she pondered how it had come to be. In this way she remained a widow, and with regard to (Darkness), he was [21] [astounded] that he no longer dwelt inside her, because the forms still possessed a power of fire and of light.
The Son of the Majesty Seeks to Desolate Nature

(The power) persisted, so that it would dwell in Nature until every power is stripped from her, because precisely like the light of the Spirit was completed with three clouds, so is it necessary that the power dwelling in Hades will also be completed at the designated time, because on account of the graciousness of the Majesty, I approached her from the water a second time, because my face was pleasant to her.

Her face also was gladdened, and I said to her: “Let seed and power be produced from you on the earth.” And she heeded the desire of the Spirit, so that she might be rendered into nothing, and when her forms returned, they rubbed each other with their tongue, copulating, begetting spirits, and demons, and the power from the fire, and Darkness, and the Spirit. The form, however, which remained by itself, threw the beast away from herself. She did not have intercourse. Instead, it was she who, remaining alone, stroked herself, and she produced a wind with a power derived from the fire, and Darkness, and the Spirit.

And so that the [22] demons could also be liberated from the power they possessed from the unclean intercourse, a womb that looked like water was together with the winds, and an unclean phallus was among the demons, as is the case with Darkness and how from the beginning he and the womb had stroked each other.

And after the forms of Nature had clung together, they separated from each other, throwing off the power, astounded at how they had been fooled. They mourned with a continual mourning. With their power, they covered themselves, and when I had humiliated them, I stood up with my power, with my garment which is superior to the beast, because it is a light, so that I could desolate Nature.

Mind, which had appeared in dark Nature, even the eye of the heart of Darkness, at my desire controlled the spirits and the demons, and I made him to look like fire, light, and attention, and to share in the truthful Logos. Consequently, some of the greatness was bestowed on him, so that he would be strong in his power, but nevertheless lack the power, lack the light of the Spirit, and lack the intercourse of Darkness, so that at the end of time, [23] when Nature will be destroyed, he may repose in the praiseworthy place, because he will be declared faithful, given that he had detested the pollution of Nature together with the Darkness. The strong power of the mind derived its existence from Mind and the unbegotten Spirit.
The Birth of Humanity
